stem.text: Carvone is found in spearmint oil.

stem.label: carvone
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of carvone: cyclohexenone ring with a C=O group, a C=C bond bearing a methyl group, and a prop-1-en-2-yl group on the ring carbon opposite the carbonyl side.

stem.text: Which product is formed when carvone is reacted with $\text{NaBH}_4$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with an OH group, a methyl group on the C=C carbon, and a prop-1-en-2-yl group on the ring.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: saturated cyclohexanone ring with a C=O group, a methyl group and an isopropyl group.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohex-2-enone ring with a C=O group, a methyl group on the C=C carbon and an isopropyl group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: saturated cyclohexanol ring with an OH group, a methyl group and an isopropyl group.
